newsitem.title: GREECE: Mytilineos signs deal with Trepca Mines.
newsitem.headline: Mytilineos signs deal with Trepca Mines.

text.p: Metals trading company Mytilineos signed on Monday a five-year $517 million deal with RMHK Trepca Mines in rump Yugoslavia at a ceremony at the national economy ministry.

Deputy National Economy Minister Alexandros Baltas said it was a significant commercial agreement which fosters friendship between the two countries and sets the stage for a mutual entrepreneurial foray into international markets.
The deal calls for the modernisation of Trepca's mines and the distribution of final product to international markets by Mytilineos.
Shares of Mytilineos rose sharply, gaining 255 drachmas to settle at 3,451 on heavy volume.
Rump Yugoslavia's central bank governor Bozidar Gazivoda was also present at the signing ceremony.
He hailed the agreement and said the investment would contribute to the country's economic recovery.
